messages:
sarah (Partnerships): Hey team — quick thread to line up KeyHarbor marketplace onboarding: SSO (SAML), SCIM, BYO-KMS/HSM handshake, and a short embargo plan.

eli (PM): Checklist: 1) SAML metadata exchange 2) SCIM user+group smoke 3) KMS wrap/unwrap latency + attestation 4) secrets connector end-to-end 5) embargo window.

pat (KeyHarbor): We can provide SAML metadata URL and a staging SCIM. BYO-KMS gateway available via VPN; attestation cert will be provided.

noah (Eng): Please upload metadata to a signed expiring link and include expected SAML attributes. Also need SCIM token and callback IPs.

pat (KeyHarbor): Uploaded: https://files.keyharbor/staging/saml-meta.xml (48h). Attributes: email, displayName, groups. SCIM token will be sent via vault.

maya (Security): Security must have IP allowlist, HSM attestation (cert + firmware hash), KMS key policy, and p50/p95/p99 latency numbers.

oliver (SolutionsEng): Quick smoke run plan: 1) create test user via SCIM 2) assign group 3) create secret via KeyHarbor API 4) rotate key 5) fetch secret from Redwood runtime. I'll share run commands.

noah (Eng): Run commands (staging):
```
curl -X POST https://scim.staging.keyharbor/v2/Users -H 'Authorization: Bearer <scim>' -d '{"userName":"rbx-smoke","emails":[{"value":"eng+smoke@redwood.com"}]}'
curl -X POST https://staging.keyharbor/api/secrets -H 'Authorization: Bearer <api>' -d '{"name":"rbx/smoke","value":"s3cret"}'
REDWOOD_SECRET=keyharbor://rbx/smoke node scripts/get-secret.js
```

eli (PM): Tentative timeline: internal dry-run Mon, partner validation Tue, marketplace canary Wed. Legal needs MSA redline + embargo window by Tue 11:00 PT.

legal-bot: Please upload MSA redline to /collab/partners/KeyHarbor before Tue 11:00 PT. Failure may delay announcement.

pat (KeyHarbor): Will deliver attestation and latency telemetry by EOD tomorrow. SCIM rate-limit headers supported.

maya (Security): Two outstanding items: SCIM bulk throttling behavior and max concurrent KMS ops for connector queue config.

pat (KeyHarbor): SCIM supports chunked bulk with Retry-After. KMS staging metrics: p50=6ms, p95=20ms, p99=45ms, max concurrent=180. We'll provide formal telemetry.

oliver (SolutionsEng): We'll implement jittered backoff and queueing on our side.

sarah (Partnerships): Actions: Pat upload attestation/telemetry + MSA (by EOD tomorrow); Noah/Oliver finalize runbook and throttling support (by Mon); Maya share IP allowlist template (today); Eli draft embargo + announcement outline (by Mon).

sarah (Partnerships): Scheduling a 30-min smoke-test call Tue 09:00 PT. Invite with runbook coming. Keep marketplace copy internal until legal sign-off.

pat (KeyHarbor): Acknowledged. We'll join with infra lead.

maya (Security): I'll join for checklist sign-off.

noah (Eng): I'll be on the call with staging harness ready.

eli (PM): Thanks all.
